title: My Mother
simplified_paragraphs: 明天是妈妈的生日，她今年55岁。她有一个姐姐和两个弟弟。她不喜欢喝咖啡，但是很喜欢吃水果。她在医院工作，是一个医生，每天都很忙，工作的时间很长。有时候她下午6点下班，有时候晚上10点下班。她也喜欢买东西，所以她非常喜欢去商店。
traditional_paragraphs: 明天是媽媽的生日，她今年55歲。她有一個姐姐和兩個弟弟。她不喜歡喝咖啡，但是很喜歡吃水果。她在醫院工作，是一個醫生，每天都很忙，工作的時間很長。有時候她下午6點下班，有時候晚上10點下班。她也喜歡買東西，所以她非常喜歡去商店。
pinyin_paragraphs: míng tiān shì mā ma de shēng rì， tā jīn nián 55 suì。 tā yǒu yī gè jiě jie hé liǎng gè dì di。 tā bù xǐ huan hē kā fēi， dàn shì hěn xǐ huan chī shuǐ guǒ。 tā zài yī yuàn gōng zuò， shì yī gè yī shēng， měi tiān dōu hěn máng， gōng zuò de shí jiān hěn cháng。 yǒu shí hou tā xià wǔ 6 diǎn xià bān， yǒu shí hou wǎn shang 10 diǎn xià bān。 tā yě xǐ huan mǎi dōng xi， suǒ yǐ tā fēi cháng xǐ huan qù shāng diàn。
english_paragraphs: Tomorrow is my mother's birthday. She is turning 55. She has an older sister and two younger brothers. She doesn't like coffee, but she loves fruit. She works at a hospital as a doctor. She is busy every day and works long hours. Sometimes she gets off work at 6 p.m., and sometimes not until 10 p.m. She also likes shopping, so she loves going to stores.
english_full: Tomorrow is my mother's birthday. She is turning 55. She has an older sister and two younger brothers. She doesn't like coffee, but she loves fruit. She works at a hospital as a doctor. She is busy every day and works long hours. Sometimes she gets off work at 6 p.m., and sometimes not until 10 p.m. She also likes shopping, so she loves going to stores.
